data.title: 塔露拉 · 假日温室花市挑选白山茶花
data.description: 绿意盎然的阳光温室花房内，塔露拉身着一袭优雅的黑金丝绒长裙。她停步在层层叠叠的木质花架前，白皙的手指轻轻托起一朵盛开的雪白山茶花，低头轻嗅清甜的花香。银灰长发自然垂落肩头，龙角与花朵交相辉映，展现出难能可贵的恬静温婉。
data.location: 阳光充盈的城市植物温室花坊一隅
data.action: 俯身轻托白山茶花低头轻嗅，神情温婉安宁
data.lighting: 玻璃花房顶棚洒下的大片柔和漫射天光
promptTokens: black velvet dress with gold trim
data.promptProse: Standing amid the lush greenery of the botanical glasshouse, she pauses before a tiered wooden stand of blooming white camellias. The black velvet of her gown brushes against ferns as she cups a pristine blossom and takes in its fragrance with peaceful grace.
data.animaCaption: She gently cups a blooming white camellia blossom in the sunlit greenhouse, smiling softly.
